== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran (Errata)]] (<code>1273_30</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-02-Wes_Janson_Rogue_Veteran.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-wesjansonrogueveteran-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn may ▼ (or deploy from hand) Disrupter Pistol for free on Wes. May fire Disruptor Pistol for 1 Force. Power and Forfeit +1 when with Hobbie or Wedge. If about to leave table place cards aboard Wes in owner's Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_30</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block set mark, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-02-Wes_Janson_Rogue_Veteran-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B12 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
